title: Show hold reason
text: When a patient result is held, the technologist worklist shall display the hold reason, including the QC rule violated and its severity.

title: Supervised override of QC-warning hold
text: A user with the Supervisor role shall be able to release a result held for a QC warning only after entering their user ID and a free-text reason; the override shall be recorded in the audit log. Override shall not be available for results held due to a QC reject.

title: Send held status to LIS
text: When a result is held, LabBridge shall send the LIS a standard HL7 v2.5 message indicating the result is not final, with the hold reason in an NTE segment.

title: Notify on hold
text: The technologist shall be notified promptly when a result is held.
